answer: Resist sybils by making each new identity lock a refundable work bond that vests only after many epochs of attested, graded output. A whisper-thin clone farm cannot cheaply echo a unique history, because every extra name immobilizes capital and must wait; the bond is forfeited if the identity fails honeypot checks or abandons its seats. Identity multiplication then costs delayed, linear capital rather than a free signup, so an attacker who wants even a marble of voting weight cannot recycle funds immediately.
